column_description: A TEXT primary key uniquely identifying each symptom and risk assessment record, linking to AssessmentBasics(AB_Key).
Patient Health Questionnaire-9 total score, ranging from 0 to 27, measuring depression severity.
PHQ-9 depression severity level based on total score. Contains values: 'Moderately Severe', 'Mild', 'Moderate', 'Severe'. Contains NULL when PHQ-9 is not administered.
Generalized Anxiety Disorder 7-item scale total score, ranging from 0 to 21, measuring anxiety severity.
GAD-7 anxiety severity level based on total score. Contains values: 'Mild', 'Moderate', 'Severe'. Contains NULL when GAD-7 is not administered.
Presence and severity of suicidal ideation. Contains values: 'Intent', 'Active', 'Plan', 'Passive', 'None'. Contains NULL when suicidal ideation assessment is not completed.
Overall suicide risk level assessment. Contains values: 'Medium', 'High', 'Low'.
History and current status of self-harm behaviors. Contains values: 'Recent', 'Remote', 'Current', 'None'. Contains NULL when self-harm assessment is not conducted.
Assessment of violence risk toward others. Contains values: 'Medium', 'Low', 'High'.
Current substance use status. Contains values: 'Cannabis', 'Opioids', 'Alcohol', 'Multiple', 'None'. Contains NULL when substance use assessment is not completed.
Frequency of substance use when present. Contains values: 'Daily', 'Occasional', 'Weekly', 'Never'.
Severity level of substance use disorder when present. Contains values: 'Moderate', 'Mild', 'Severe'. Contains NULL when substance use severity is not evaluated.
